items.title: Delta (DAL) Stock May Stay Reasonable As Profitability Holds Up
items.summary: Delta Air Lines has delivered a strong 5 year share price run, yet the recent pullback and a mixed overall value score mean investors are weighing how much upside is left at the current valuation. The stock has returned 96.1% over 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains already reflect the company’s fundamentals. items.title: Oil Price Rally Helps Energy Stocks, Hurts Airlines
items.summary: The 5% jump in U.S. crude oil prices today is having some of the familiar effects we've seen in recent months across the market when tensions build in the Middle East.    Winners largely are coming from the energy sector, which is the best performing group in the S&P 500 today.
